notes.title: Devlog 2024 - Walker AI - Moons of Darsalon - Devlog EP11
notes.content:
In this video, we continue to explore the advanced Walker AI in Moons of Darsalon. NPCs not only navigate complex, dynamic terrain but also find platforms and jump with remarkable accuracy. Unlike in typical platformer games, these NPCs move freely across the map without being confined to specific platforms, showcasing a more sophisticated AI system. Learn how the AI overcomes challenges that most platformer games face with NPC movement and see the debug tools in action, visualizing every raycast.

[previewyoutube=4Gf73R0ydA4;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Devlog 2024 - Walker AI - Moons of Darsalon - Devlog EP10
notes.content:
In this video, we explore the Walker AI in Moons of Darsalon, where NPCs navigate challenging terrain, jump between platforms, and interact dynamically with the environment. Unlike typical platformers, Moons of Darsalon features advanced AI that surpasses many games like Hollow Knight. Join us to learn how these systems push the boundaries of NPC behavior in platform games and improve gameplay through smarter character actions.

[previewyoutube=5vtQYU5VKTA;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Dev Log - The Making of "Moons of Darsalon" video series!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

I'm excited to announce my new video series: "The Making Of Moons of Darsalon!" Join me, as I take you through the intricate process of developing Moons of Darsalon.

In these videos, I'll cover a range of topics, including:

Pixel-perfect retro rendering
Dynamic 2D lighting techniques
Custom shaders for more realistic shadows
Platformer AI
Unique animation systems for characters
Creating immersive environments

Whether you're a game developer or a gaming enthusiast, there's something here for you. Don't miss out on these behind-the-scenes insights and learn how I brought Moons of Darsalon to life.

Subscribe and stay tuned for the next episode!

[previewyoutube=l2I16ZogZdo;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: This retro-futuristic platformer about rescuing spacemen on an alien moon might be the perfect Steam Deck game
notes.content: The escort mission is one of the most reviled of videogame tropes, but solo-developed platformer Moons Of Darsalon boldly leans into it as its whole deal. Darsalon is a puzzle-platformer in the vein of Lemmings, tasking you with hunting down hapless "Darsonauts" in its sprawling levels, then shepherding them to safety... Read more.

notes.title: This Lemmings-like platformer drove me to the brink (in a good way) trying to rescue its hapless astronauts
notes.content: Moons of Darsalon is that rare sort of game that makes an escort mission fun. Instead of trying to just get your guy to the end of a level, this '50s raygun sci-fi platformer sees you rescuing fellow spacemen and herding them through gauntlets of escalating difficulty and complexity... Read more.

notes.title: LEVEL EDITOR FOR EVERYONE TO USE COMING VERY SOON
notes.content:
The level editor will be a child unity project that can only be used to make levels and export directly into your installed Moons of Darsalon directory with just one click.

It will use all the proprietary tools I have made to build levels myself including the paint style terrain maker, that uses different pencils to draw the terrain shape and the texture will be generated automatically

Also you can use the random terrain generator to use as a starting point!

Place Darsanauts and gadgets with F8 , enemies and enemy spawners with F9, platforms with F10 , background rocks with F11 and so on...

For more information you can join our DISCORD-> https://discord.gg/deh9Gwn
